properties.displayName: PSOC - Suspicious JavaScript Execution via Deno
properties.description:
Deno is a legitimate JavaScript/TypeScript runtime.  It is used to run scripts, build web servers, create command-line tools, and compile code into self-contained executables.
This rule fires when a Deno process is started with a command line matching suspicious patterns: javascript with base64, eval(, http, or javascript import. 
Such patterns are commonly used to run inline or remote scripts and can indicate abuse.
